resources.string: This build saves your proxies but doesn\'t connect yet. Connecting arrives with the VPN service in a later version.
No account, ads or analytics. ProxyFlow has no servers of its own.
Profiles stay on this phone. Usernames and passwords are encrypted with an Android Keystore key that is never exported or backed up. A password is only ever sent to the proxy it was saved for.
Your proxy provider can see which sites you visit and any unencrypted data.
Websites and most apps (TCP) and website names (DNS) go through your proxy.
UDP (calls, some games) and ping are blocked, and local devices like printers can\'t be reached.
IPv6 addresses work only if your proxy supports IPv6.
ProxyFlow is free and independent. It isn\'t affiliated with any proxy provider.
